hp.special: 7 + five times your commoner level (it has a number of d12 hit dice equal to your level)

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: Your Companion counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, lift, or pull.

trait.name: Charge (Male Only)
entries: If your Companion moves 20 feet toward a creature and attacks it with Stomp attack on the same turn, any creature one size larger then your Livestock or smaller must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Farmer's Bond
entries: Whenever your PB increases, your Companion's saving throw DC, saving throw bonus, and passive {@skill Perception} each increase by 1.

trait.name: Mother's Milk (Female Only)
entries: At the end of a long rest, your Companion produces PB bottles of milk, which restore {@dice 2d4 + PB} hit points when consumed.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 + PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + 3} bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Draconic Companion

hp.special: 5 + five times your Magus level (your Companion has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Magus level)

languages: understands any languages spoken by the Magus bound to it

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: Your Companion has a total number of {@dice d8} Hit Dice equal to your Magus level. It also gains all the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Soul Bond
entries: When the Companion is forced to make an ability check or saving throw, it adds your PB to its roll.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +3 +PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h} ({@damage 1d4 +3 +PB}) slashing damage + {@damage 1d4} Essence damage.

monster.name: Exalted Companion
languages: understands any languages spoken by the Magus bound to it.

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: The Companion has a number of {@dice d10} Hit Dice equal to your Magus level. It also gains all the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Soul Bound
entries: You add your PB to any ability check or saving throw that your Draconic Companion makes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Your Companion makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Change Size
entries: Your Companion changes size, becoming Small, Medium, or Large until it uses this feature again.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h} {@damage 2d6 +5} magical slashing damage + {@damage 1d6} Essence damage.

action.name: Essence Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Your Companion can exhale elemental energy in a 30-foot cone, forcing any creatures in that area to make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures take {@damage 12d6} Essence damage on a failure, and half as much damage on a success.
This replaces your {@subclassFeature Elemental Breath|Magus|LLMC|Dragon Knight|LLMC|15} feature.

monster.name: Exalted Spirit Dragon
languages: understands the languages you speak, but the Spirit Dragon can only speak Draconic

trait.name: Ethereal Agility
entries: Whenever the Spirit Dragon makes an ability check or saving throw that uses Dexterity, it can add your Wisdom modifier to the result.

trait.name: Serpentine
entries: The thin, serpentine body of the Spirit Dragon counts as Medium for the purposes of its carrying capacity, the spaces it can move through, and all features except for the space it occupies.

action.name: Spectral Slash
entries: Melee Attack: your Shaman spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 + WIS} necrotic damage.

action.name: Spirit Breath
entries: The Spirit Dragon forces all creatures in a 60-foot line or a 30-foot cone to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they suffer the effects of your Totemic Assault. On a success, targets suffer half the damage of Totemic Assault, but not effects.

monster.name: Geist Spirit
languages: understands any languages its Spirit Guide speaks, but the Geist cannot speak itself.

trait.name: Conduit
entries: Whenever you cast a Shaman spell, you can choose for the spell to originate from the Geist.

trait.name: Ethereal Bond
entries: You add your PB to any ability check or saving throw that the Geist is forced to make.

trait.name: Ghastly Glide
entries: Even though the Geist has a fly speed, it can only fly a maximum of 10 feet above a surface.

trait.name: Totem Bearer
entries: When you conjure your Geist, you can transfer any number of your Bound Totems to it. The Geist gains the benefits of the Totems, and you lose their benefits until the end of your next long rest.

action.name: Spectral Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} Your Spell Attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3} necrotic damage. On hit, The target suffers the effects of your Totemic Assault.

trait.name: Bestial Traits
entries: Each transformation, the Great Beast gains a number of Bestial Traits from the list at the end of this Spirituality equal to your Slot Level.

trait.name: Primal Fury
entries: When the Great Beast makes an ability check or saving throw that uses Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution, it adds your PB to its roll.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} Spell Attack Modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + WIS} piercing damage.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} Spell Attack Modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 + WIS} slashing damage.

monster.name: Spirit Dragon
languages: understands the languages you speak, but the Spirit Dragon can only speak Draconic

trait.name: Ethereal Agility
entries: Whenever the Spirit Dragon makes an ability check or saving throw that uses Dexterity, it can add your Wisdom modifier to the result.

trait.name: Serpentine
entries: The thin, serpentine body of the Spirit Dragon counts as Medium for the purposes of its carrying capacity, the spaces it can move through, and all features except for the space it occupies.

action.name: Spectral Slash
entries: Melee Attack: your Shaman spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + WIS} necrotic damage.

action.name: Spirit Breath
entries: The Spirit Dragon forces creatures in a 30-foot line to make a Dexterity saving throw. They suffer the effects of Totemic Assault on a failure, and take half damage from Totemic Assault on a success but suffer no additional Totemic Assault effects.

trait.name: Gaseous
entries: The Archon can move through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing, and while using its flying speed, opportunity attacks have disadvantage against it.

trait.name: Bluster
entries: Whenever the Archon deals thunder damage to a creature with an Iridescent Strike, it can knock it back 10 feet in a straight line. This distance is halved for each size the target is above the Archon.

trait.name: Elder Elemental
entries: When the Archon deals Affinity damage, it ignores Resistance and treats Immunity as Resistance.

trait.name: Astral Step
entries: Whenever the Archon casts a spell, it can teleport a number of feet equal to 10 times the spell level (minimum 10) to an unoccupied space it sees.

action.name: Arcane Blast
entries: Once on its turn, the Archon forgo one attack to cause a burst of magic at a point it can see within 60 feet. Creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take damage as if they had been hit by one of your {@classFeature Iridescent Strikes|Vessel|LLVessel|1||Iridescent Strikes}.

trait.name: Infernal Drain
entries: Once per turn when the Archon deals fire damage with an Iridescent Strike, its temporary hit points increase by your Charisma modifier. Your total temporary hit points cannot exceed twice your Vessel level.

trait.name: Frenzy
entries: When it takes the Attack action, the Archon can enter a Frenzy which lasts until the start of its next turn. For the duraiton all of its attacks, and all attacks targeting the Archon, are made with advantage.

trait.name: Rock Solid
entries: When the Archon deals bludgeoning damage to a creature with an Iridescent Strike, the target's speed is halved until the start of the Archon's following turn.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: When the Archon deals bludgeoning damage to a non-magical object or structure, it deals the maximum possible damage instead of rolling.

trait.name: Elder Elemental
entries: When the Archon deals Affinity damage, it ignores Resistance and treats Immunity as Resistance.

trait.name: Divine Ward
entries: As a bonus action, the Archon can grant a creature it can see within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier, which last 1 minute.

trait.name: Wings of Wrath
entries: When the Archon uses Divine Wrath, it gains the Thrown (20/60) property, and after the attack, the weapon instantly returns to the Archon's hand.

trait.name: Searing Flame
entries: Whenever the Archon deals fire damage, it rolls its damage twice and chooses which total to use.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The Archon sheds bright light out to a 30-foot radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that.

trait.name: Elder Elemental
entries: When the Archon deals Affinity damage, it ignores Resistance and treats Immunity as Resistance.

trait.name: Pseudopod
entries: The Archon sprouts a number of additional pseudopod limbs equal to your Charisma modifier. They have a reach of 10 ft., and they can be attacked as part of the Archon. These pseudopods can only be used to make melee Iridescent Strike attacks, Grapple, and Shove.

trait.name: Sticky Slime
entries: When the Archon hits a creature equal to its size or smaller with a melee Iridescent Strike, it can force it to make a Dexterity saving throw or become Grappled. To escape this Grapple, a creature must use its action to make a Strength saving throw, escaping on a success.

monster.name: Spirit Familiar
languages: any spoken by your Archon Form

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: The Spirit Familiar has a number of {@dice d4} Hit Dice equal to your Vessel level. It also gains all the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Vessel Bond
entries: You add your PB to any ability checks or saving throws that your Spirit Familiar makes.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Spirit Familiar has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The Familiar magically turns invisible until it attacks or forces a target to make an ability check or saving throw. Equipment it is wearing or carrying turns invisible with it. The Familiar must concentrate on this effect as if it were concentrating on a spell.

action.name: Spirit Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 + 3} damage of the same type as your Iridescent Strikes.

trait.name: Stolen Memory
entries: Once per turn when the Archon deals psychic damage with an Iridescent Strike, it can force the target to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it cannot see, hear, smell, sense, or target the Archon in any way until the start of your next turn.

trait.name: Juxtapose
entries: As a bonus action, the Archon can force a creature it can see within 60 feet to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it instantly switches places with the Archon. A creature can willingly fail the save.

trait.name: Aqueous
entries: The Archon can breathe normally in both air and water, and it can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Flowing Resilience
entries: When the Archon takes damage it can use a reaction to reduce it by CHA and move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. It cannot use this reaction on force or psychic damage.

trait.name: Elder Elemental
entries: When the Archon deals Affinity damage, it ignores Resistance and treats Immunity as Resistance.

trait.name: Heroic Determination
entries: Once per long rest, when your Protege misses an attack roll, or fails an ability check or saving throw, they can choose to replace their d20 roll with your Warlord level, possibly making it a success.

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: Your Protege has a number of {@dice d8} Hit Dice equal to your Warlord level. They also gain the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Quick Student
entries: Each time your PB increases by 1, your Protege's bonus to their saving throws, skills, and their attack bonus also increase by the same amount.

action.name: Extra Attack
entries: When you command your Protege to make a weapon attack, they make two attacks instead of one.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}({@damage 2d6 +4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} +8 to hit, range 150/600, one target. {@h}({@damage 1d8 +3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: Your Protege has a number of {@dice d8} Hit Dice equal to your Warlord level. They also gain the normal benefits of both short and long rests.

trait.name: Quick Student
entries: Each time your PB increases by 1, your Protege's bonus to their saving throws, skills, and their attack bonus also increase by the same amount.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}({@damage 1d4 +3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} +5 to hit, range 80/320, one target. {@h}({@damage 1d6 +3}) piercing damage.
